name: Fix Test Failure (Learning)
description: LLM-assisted test fix that learns from patterns. Traces contribute to Thompson Sampling for improved future fixes.

impulses.description: Past successful test fixes to learn from

tasks.description: Identify the failure pattern and check for similar past fixes

prompt.template:
Analyze this test failure:

```
{{errorLog}}
```

{{#if similar-fixes}}
I have access to similar past fixes that worked. Review those patterns.
{{/if}}

1. Read the failing test file(s)
2. Read the implementation file(s) being tested
3. Identify the failure pattern (assertion mismatch, type error, missing mock, etc.)
4. Determine if this matches a known pattern from past fixes

tasks.description: Apply the most likely fix based on learned patterns

prompt.template:
Based on your analysis and any similar past fixes, apply the fix:

1. If this matches a known pattern, use that approach
2. Make minimal, targeted changes
3. Fix the root cause, not the symptom
4. If fixing implementation, ensure tests are actually correct
5. If fixing tests, ensure they still validate the right behavior

Use the edit tool to apply changes.

tasks.description: Verify fix with deterministic test execution
